BiblicalUsage: Tibni is a son of Ginath who was made king over half of Israel in rivalry with Omri. In 1 Kings 16:21, half of the people followed Tibni the son of Ginath. The fuller story is told on the Tibni, King of Israel profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that Tibni belongs in the story because God put the name there, and I trust the placing.
